issue.title: Repair the album parent on sase_blog_zettel/sase_is_too_complex.md
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-ms.8.3.1.3 note 2, corroborated by its final note 6 and triaged by bob-cli-ms.8.3.1.land.

The independent read-only audit discovered 193 canonical records. Exactly one, sase_blog_zettel/sase_is_too_complex.md, has parent resolving to the vault root instead of the owning sase_blog_zettel album. Both exact e07a26bf and pristine 3617c2ea binaries reject records show with exit 2 and record_parent_mismatch. Its full SHA256 was af803e16edf35f44a53576a0efd44f0ad673aedc41b30b0caec088e2dfb6d3ca before and after the probes. Seven authored keys remain uncovered: claim, created, parent, section, status, title, type. No live note was edited and no allowlist hides the failure.

Scope is small because the evidenced defect is one incorrect parent link. Read current vault instructions and the current record/album before writing; do not assume the captured preimage is still current. Confirm the intended owning album, repair only this record's parent using the supported vault workflow, preserve every other authored byte, and verify records show succeeds with exactly one display home per authored key. Rerun the read-only record-card-vault-coverage.py audit to confirm this rejection is gone, reporting any concurrent edits honestly. Do not relax the ownership guard, add an audit allowlist, perform provenance cleanup, or claim the whole audit passes if other findings emerge.

Evidence: file:explicit:925b70926af44650172dea5b (independent current/baseline rejection); file:explicit:6c29e2ed7ad7cd9f4e9a88db (final 193-record audit and explicit coverage gap).

Duplicate search across all statuses for record_parent_mismatch, sase_is_too_complex, parent/album and ownership plus the last-week task sweep found no duplicate. bob-cli-mq concerns unsafe Bases editing, not repair of this evidenced one-note parent; no provenance proves Bases caused it. Active epic scopes were reviewed: Record Card reads expose this existing data rejection but do not author this parent, and the title/H1 work explicitly leaves frontmatter unchanged. No credible causal active epic was identified.

task_type_fields.impact: This record cannot be opened through records show; seven authored keys remain outside verified Record Card coverage.
task_type_fields.repro: bob records show sase_blog_zettel sase_is_too_complex -f json exits 2 with record_parent_mismatch on both e07a26bf and pristine 3617c2ea.
